summarize_PASSABLE_BLOCKS: summarize the PASSABLE_BLOCKS tuple listing Minecraft block IDs that an agent can walk through
summarize_BLOCK_GROUPS: summarize the BLOCK_GROUPS dictionary mapping block type names to lists of Minecraft block IDs
summarize_COLOR_BID_MAP: summarize the COLOR_BID_MAP dictionary mapping color names to wool block ID and metadata pairs
summarize_BUILD_BLOCK_REPLACE_MAP: summarize the BUILD_BLOCK_REPLACE_MAP dictionary defining which blocks to replace with air or stone during building
summarize_REMOVABLE_BLOCKS: summarize the REMOVABLE_BLOCKS tuple listing Minecraft block IDs that can be safely removed by an agent
